companyIntro.paragraphAr: نطمح في تــــــــام العربية أن نكون من الشركات الرائدة في مجال إنشاء الحدائق وتنسيقها وتنفيذ ما يلزمها من شبكات ري أوتوماتيكي وأعمال الرصفة والإنارة وإنشاءات الظل. وتزامناً مع رؤية المملكة في مكافحة التصحر وزيادة الغطاء النباتي، ترى تــــــــام العربية أن هناك طلباً على مشاريع الزراعة والري ومشاريع المنظر الحضري، لذا تمكنت الشركة من توظيف الكوادر من مهندسين وفنيين وعمالة ماهرة لنكون على مستوى عالٍ لتنفيذ وصيانة مشاريع الحدائق وتشجير المدن والطرق.
companyIntro.paragraphEn1: We aspire in the TAM ALARABIYA to be one of the leading companies in the field of landscape for hardscape and softscape, agriculture and irrigation.
companyIntro.paragraphEn2: In conjunction with the vision of the Kingdom in combating desertification and increasing the vegetation cover, TAM ALARABIYA sees that there is a demand for agricultural projects and urban landscape projects, so the company was able to employ cadres, technicians and skilled labour to be at a high level to implement and maintain afforestation and irrigation projects, landscape projects for gardens, roads and neighbourhoods.

specializations.title: TAM Alarabiya specialized in three main majors:
items: Earth work excavation & backfilling work, road work.
specializations.paragraph1: We have hired and trained teams consisting of a supervisor and trained workers for each team, all of them with previous experience and knowledge in the fields of the company.
specializations.paragraph2: Since establishment, the company has focused on growth by securing projects and employing technical staff to ensure speed and quality of delivery.

planning.title: To plan:
planning.text: Elaborate planning of the project before receiving it, and identifying and preparing teams of technicians, labour and equipment before receiving the project.

resources.title: Securing resources:
resources.text: Financial resources, adjusting the workflow budget according to the agreed items, weekly follow-up to the project timeline, and supplying labour teams and equipment when needed.

workflow.title: Workflow:
workflow.text: Follow-up with official authorities to ensure the progress of work, prepare sites, and develop a weekly plan for the completion of each project.

delivery.title: Delivery Team:
delivery.text: Deliver projects to official authorities according to engineering and technical specifications by the consultant.

companyVision.title: Our Vision
companyVision.heading: Vision
companyVision.paragraph1: Our vision is focused on growth and expansion, as the company has taken a growth plan by increasing technicians and skilled labors according to the projects entrusted to it.
companyVision.paragraph2: We are keen to implement projects within the specified project timeline.
